distractors.reason: We don't say 'make a test'. 'Make' is used with decisions, plans, choices and mistakes.
We don't say 'do a test' in standard English. 'Do' is used with tasks such as homework or the dishes.
We don't say 'have a test'. 'Have' is used with lunch, a break or a shower.

example_sentence: You need to ___ a test on Friday.
l1_interference: Türkçe konuşanlar 'test yapmak' gibi bire bir çeviri yaparak 'do a test' diyebilir. İngilizcede doğrusu 'take a test' kullanılır.
explanation: In English, 'take' is used with tests, exams, classes and breaks. Think of it as 'accepting' or 'joining' an event that happens at a set time.

related_collocations.example: Many students take an exam at the end of the year.
I do my homework every evening.
Everyone can make a mistake when they are learning.

memory_tip: TAKE = join or accept (a test, an exam, a break) | DO = perform a task (homework, work) | MAKE = create (a mistake, a plan)
